description: Head-movement mini-game G05: clock-point neck exercise, voice-guided. The flagship anti-circling teaching game: fixed non-circular 8-cue sequence 12, 9, 6, 3, 9, 12, 3, 6 — each cue is one clock position reached, held about 0.8 seconds, and returned from, never a sweep around the dial. Two start calibrations learn down (up is opposite pitch) and left (right is opposite yaw) from AbsoluteOrientationSensor vs a calibrated center. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: neck-clock
